title: Best Bookshelf (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were selected from PCMag, RTINGS, CNET, and TechGearLab reviews, prioritizing products mentioned by multiple sites and noting key features and drawbacks.
assumptions: Prices are omitted because none of the sources provide them.

verdict.line: Picture a living room where music flows from a sleek, wall‑mounted speaker that doubles as a shelf. The IKEA SYMFONISK delivers balanced mid‑range sound, integrates with Sonos and Apple AirPlay 2, and is affordable. Its main catch is that it lacks Bluetooth and the bracket isn’t included.
